name: RC-B10-0208/2024 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Hong Kong, notably the cases of Jimmy Lai and the 45 activists recently convicted under the national security law
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking for action. It condemns Hong Kong's national security law and the jailing of pro-democracy activists, including Jimmy Lai and the 45 known as the "Hong Kong 47". It calls for their release and for the law to be scrapped. It also asks the European Union to warn China, consider sanctions on Hong Kong officials, and support activists.

- Nothing changes yet; this is the Parliament's opinion and a set of requests.
- It targets Hong Kong and Chinese officials, and EU governments and diplomats.
- Next, EU bodies and member states decide whether to act on the requests.
